dedupe_keys.name: synthetic population democratization of electric vehicle charging infrastructure

description: University of California Davis researchers publish a synthetic household population for electric-vehicle adoption analysis in California. Zenodo supplies a compressed CSV and README free under CC0. Census-tract records include household composition, vehicle body types, home-charging access and probabilities that two household vehicles are electric. Small- and large-vehicle electrification scenarios distribute eight million hypothetical vehicles across six million households. The population uses American Community Survey 2015–2019, 2017 National Household Travel Survey and charging-access probabilities. These inputs can inform spatial charging-demand and equity simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this enriched synthetic population. Coverage is scenario-based California households, not observed vehicle purchases or actual charger access at each address. Source survey biases and enrichment assumptions affect small-area estimates. No compressed CSV was downloaded or synthetic-population calibration checked.
